review_note: Retains fppf locality on SOURCE of locally finite presentation for any f:X→Y, comparing all composites Xi→Y with f.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ an fppf covering. Then $f$ is locally of finite presentation if and only if each composite $f\circ a_i:X_i\to Y$ is locally of finite presentation.
hypotheses: f:X→Y with an fppf covering of X.
conclusions: Local finite presentation is fppf-local on source.

review_note: Retains fppf locality on SOURCE of locally finite type morphisms, not mistakenly the stronger locally finite presentation claim.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a scheme morphism and $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ an fppf covering. Then $f$ is locally of finite type if and only if all composites $f\circ a_i$ are locally of finite type.
hypotheses: f:X→Y and an fppf cover of X.
conclusions: Local finite type is fppf-local on source.

review_note: Retains openness of underlying topological map f:X→Y being fppf local on source, including descent from all open composites and converse.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes and $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ an fppf covering. Then $f$ is an open map on underlying topological spaces if and only if each composite $f\circ a_i:X_i\to Y$ is open.
hypotheses: f:X→Y with an fppf covering of its source.
conclusions: Topological openness of f is equivalent to openness of the compositions.

review_note: Retains universal openness (every base change is open) being fppf local on source; distinguishes universal from ordinary openness.
statement: Let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of schemes, and $\{a_i:X_i\to X\}$ an fppf covering of the source. A morphism is *universally open* if every base change is open on underlying topological spaces. Then $f$ is universally open if and only if each $f\circ a_i:X_i\to Y$ is universally open.
hypotheses: f and an fppf cover of X; universal openness quantified over arbitrary base changes.
conclusions: Universal openness is fppf-local on the source.
